currentState.focus: Axiom elimination and formalizability assessment complete

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED: Eliminated 2/8 axioms from Hilbert-15 Schubert calculus. Proved linesMeet_iff_linesMeet via dimension formula and transversal_count from four_lines_theorem. Detailed formalizability assessment: 2 proved, 3 medium-term (Young tableaux), 3 long-term (algebraic geometry).
insights: linesMeet_iff_linesMeet is pure linear algebra: Grassmann dimension formula finrank(V+W)+finrank(V∩W)=finrank(V)+finrank(W)
transversal_count is a logical consequence of four_lines_theorem, not an independent axiom
Combinatorial Schubert calculus (LR coefficients) needs ~1000 lines of Young tableaux in Lean
Geometric Schubert calculus (Chow rings, intersection theory) needs Mathlib infrastructure that does not exist
sigma1_fourth_power would be provable once LR coefficients are computationally defined
mathlibGaps: Algebraic cycles and rational equivalence (Chow groups)
nextSteps: Implement LR coefficients as computable def via Young tableaux
Prove Pieri rule from LR definition (would eliminate 1 more axiom)
Formalize Plücker embedding Gr(2,4) -> P5 via exterior algebra
